g.text: Input change and prediction deterioration are different signals
250 no-change streams; 40 per other scenario. Outcome audits test TPR decrease, FPR increase and accuracy decrease even when input checks are
quiet; labels arrive immediately. The combined monitor splits its 5% budget between channels. 95% Wilson intervals; no universal fairness
